vocabulary_law: Closed vocabulary (D-013-R008): every subsystem_id below IS a repo-relative directory prefix that must exist in the tree at load time, and must equal its rule's prefix byte-for-byte. Free-form taxonomy names are structurally impossible: the resolver fails closed on any rule whose subsystem_id differs from its prefix or whose prefix is not an existing directory.
resolution_law: Deterministic longest-prefix match on whole path segments; a path matching no rule resolves to unresolved with reason no_matching_subsystem_rule, never to a guessed bucket (D-013-R009/R045).
